reolink-wui-ptz-pending: Checking pan, tilt and zoom support…
reolink-wui-feed-gap: Some live events may be missing.
reolink-wui-feed-gap-history: Monitor refreshes camera state and retrieves any available events from its history.
reolink-wui-feed-gap-bridge-backlog-desc: The bridge fell behind and sent its current camera state. The affected event IDs and counts are unknown.
reolink-wui-feed-gap-failure-heartbeat: The bridge stopped responding to connection checks.
reolink-wui-feed-gap-unknown-events: The affected event IDs and counts are unknown.
reolink-wui-feed-gap-failure-authorizati: The bridge rejected the WUI credentials.
reolink-wui-feed-gap-failure-subscriptio: The event subscription could not be opened.
reolink-wui-feed-gap-failure-transport: The upstream connection closed or could not be opened.
reolink-wui-no-cameras: No cameras are assigned to your account. Ask an instance administrator for access.
reolink-wui-live-needed: Choose a stream to start viewing.
reolink-wui-live-stream-unavailable: Enable this camera’s media profile on the bridge or select an RTSP proxy in Playback.
reolink-wui-live-display: The bridge could not deliver the first video frame. Check the camera’s RTSP setting and the bridge media configuration.
reolink-wui-event-json-copy-blocked: Clipboard access is unavailable. Select and copy the JSON below.
reolink-wui-event-coordinates-unavailabl: Object coordinates are unavailable for this event.
reolink-wui-no-rules: No rules reported by the bridge.
reolink-wui-preset-photo-at: Go to preset {$id} · {$name} and refresh the preview
reolink-wui-preset-photo-wait: Waiting for the camera to reach preset {$id}…
reolink-wui-error-PTZ_PRESET_MISSING: This preset is no longer on the camera.
reolink-wui-error-PTZ_ARRIVAL_UNVERIFIED: Preset arrival could not be verified. Refresh the preview to see the current view.
reolink-wui-ptz-ready-after-check: Position refreshed. The camera is ready for another move.
reolink-wui-ptz-start-unconfirmed: Stop confirmed. The camera did not confirm the start of the move.
reolink-wui-ptz-recovering: Position will be checked again automatically.
reolink-wui-error-PTZ_PRESET_OCCUPIED: This preset number is in use. Choose another number or confirm replacement.
reolink-wui-sign-in-copy: Sign in to view and operate cameras assigned to you.
reolink-wui-no-signin: Sign in through the configured ingress to continue.
reolink-wui-unknown: Outcome unknown. Read current state before another change.
reolink-wui-settings-empty: No supported settings are available for your grant.
reolink-wui-admin-description: Manage account access, bridge inventory and device enrollment.
reolink-wui-confirm-disable: Disable this account and end its sessions?
reolink-wui-enrollment-copy: Connect the camera to the local network. You can scan its label or enter the printed identifiers to check them against the camera.
reolink-wui-enrollment-qr-copy: Scan this code with the WUI to fill in the camera identifiers.
reolink-wui-wifi-verified: Wi-Fi QR verified on Lumus E430 (IPC_NT1NO24MP). E1 Pro compatibility is unconfirmed.
reolink-wui-wifi-copy: This QR contains the Wi-Fi password. Keep it on this screen and show it to the camera.
reolink-wui-wifi-invalid: Check the Wi-Fi fields and camera code.
reolink-wui-enrollment-label-mismatch: The camera’s identity differs from the label you entered. Check the address and the printed identifiers.
reolink-wui-enrollment-configured-init: Identify the camera and check its UID against the label. The bridge will set and verify the admin password from this camera’s configuration when you start enrollment.
reolink-wui-enrollment-configured-import: The bridge will verify this camera’s configured admin password and identity when you start enrollment.
reolink-wui-error-ENROLLMENT_ADDRESS_UNK: No configured admin camera matches this IP and port on the selected bridge. Check its cameras[] entry.
reolink-wui-error-ENROLLMENT_ADDRESS_AMB: Multiple configured cameras match this address. Enter the camera’s Baichuan port and check for duplicate entries.
reolink-wui-error-ENROLLMENT_PASSWORD_IN: Set cameras[].password on the bridge to 8–31 printable ASCII characters for first-password setup.
reolink-wui-error-ENROLLMENT_IDENTIFY_FA: The bridge could not read the camera’s identity. Check its connection and camera setup choice. For an initialized camera, select Use an existing password.
reolink-wui-enrollment-confirm: I checked the printed identifier and authorize this enrollment.
reolink-wui-enrollment-status-identity-m: The camera did not report the requested identifier. Check the printed label and private target.
reolink-wui-enrollment-status-local-setu: The bridge could not set the first password. Check the camera address and supported firmware. If the admin password is already set, verify the existing bridge credential.
reolink-wui-enrollment-status-recovery-r: Neither credential could be verified. Ask the bridge operator to reconcile the private credential store before any further write.
reolink-wui-enrollment-status-previous-c: The previous credential still works. Review the camera state before starting a new rotation.
reolink-wui-enrollment-status-restart-re: The credential was verified. Restart the private bridge to activate it.
reolink-wui-enrollment-inventory-pending: Waiting for this camera to appear in the WUI inventory.
reolink-wui-enrollment-status-in-progres: The bridge is checking this operation.
reolink-wui-enrollment-unavailable: To enroll a camera, add it to cameras[] on its bridge and configure api.storageDirectory.
reolink-wui-rotate-confirm: Rotate this device credential? The private bridge may require a restart.
reolink-wui-not-supported: Unavailable with the configured camera and bridge.
reolink-wui-error-INTERNAL: The server could not complete this request.
reolink-wui-error-STORAGE_READ_FAILED: The bridge could not read this camera’s storage details.
reolink-wui-error-RECORDING_SEARCH_FAILE: The bridge could not search this camera’s recordings.
reolink-wui-error-UNSUPPORTED: This action is unavailable with the configured camera and transport.
reolink-wui-error-ACCESS_DENIED: Your account does not have access to this action.
reolink-wui-error-CSRF_DENIED: The session could not verify the request. Reload and sign in again if needed.
reolink-wui-error-LOGIN_INVALID: The username or password is incorrect.
reolink-wui-error-LOGIN_LIMIT: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in a minute.
reolink-wui-error-IDENTITY_UNLINKED: Ask an administrator to link this identity to a WUI account.
reolink-wui-error-IDENTITY_MISMATCH: Sign out before switching accounts, or check whether the identity is already linked.
reolink-wui-error-OIDC_FAILED: The identity provider did not complete sign-in.
reolink-wui-error-CAMERA_OFFLINE: The camera is offline or its state is stale.
reolink-wui-error-CAMERA_UNKNOWN: This camera is no longer registered.
reolink-wui-error-BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE: The configured bridge connection is unavailable.
reolink-wui-error-OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The bridge outcome is unknown. Check current state before retrying.
reolink-wui-error-COMMAND_BUSY: Another camera change is in progress.
reolink-wui-error-OPERATION_CONFLICT: This operation conflicts with an earlier request.
reolink-wui-error-RECONCILE_REQUIRED: Read fresh camera state before sending another change.
reolink-wui-error-SNAPSHOT_INVALID: The bridge returned an invalid capture.
reolink-wui-error-MEDIA_LIMIT: There are too many active streams. Close a stream and try again.
reolink-wui-error-ENROLLMENT_MISSING: The bridge has no record of this enrollment.
reolink-wui-error-CALLBACK_INVALID: Choose a supported destination and cameras on this bridge.
reolink-wui-status-no-upstreams: Your account has no cameras with an upstream connection to show.
reolink-wui-inventory-no-bridge: Configure a reolink-bridge connection in the WUI server configuration to discover cameras.
reolink-wui-inventory-waiting: Waiting for camera inventory from reolink-bridge. Check the upstream connections on Status.
reolink-wui-inventory-empty: The connected bridges have not reported any cameras.
reolink-wui-appearance-personal: Your choices are saved for this account in this browser.
reolink-wui-appearance-defaults-help: These defaults apply to each appearance option a user inherits.
reolink-wui-grant-no-inventory: Camera grants will be available after a bridge reports its camera inventory.
reolink-wui-callbacks-unavailable: Add an approved receiver under callbacks in the WUI bridge configuration, then restart the WUI.
reolink-wui-inventory-cadence: The WUI syncs reported camera inventory every {$seconds} seconds. The timestamp records the last manual refresh.
reolink-wui-admin-full-access: Instance administrators have full access to all cameras.
reolink-wui-history-limit: In-memory events to keep per camera
reolink-wui-history-limit-hint: Applies to in-memory history. Set to 0 to keep only the live feed.
reolink-wui-history-unavailable: Event history is temporarily unavailable. Live events are shown as they arrive.
reolink-wui-preview-connecting: Waiting for preview settings from the bridge…
reolink-wui-preview-bridge-offline: Bridge HTTP API is offline. Reconnecting…
reolink-wui-preview-unsupported: This bridge version does not report frame preview settings.
reolink-wui-preview-no-api: Frame previews require a bridge HTTP connection.
reolink-wui-preview-denied: Your account does not have live-view access to this camera.
reolink-wui-preview-unconfigured: This camera has no preview configured in the bridge. Add its camera ID under api.previews.cameras to enable frame refresh.
reolink-wui-playback-proxy-hint: Enter a private RTSP URL reachable from the WUI server.
reolink-wui-playback-direct-hint: The bridge opens the authenticated camera stream. The WUI shares it with viewers using the same stream quality.
reolink-wui-preview-bridge-configure: Enable cached previews for this camera in the bridge configuration.
reolink-wui-recordings-unavailable: Recording playback is unavailable for this camera or your account. The bridge must expose the recordings API.
reolink-wui-storage-empty: No storage card is reported by this camera.
reolink-wui-recording-link-unavailable: This recording is unavailable. It may have expired or you may need camera access.
reolink-wui-recordings-empty: No recordings found for this date.
reolink-wui-recordings-truncated: More recordings are available than this search can return.
reolink-wui-recording-playback-failed: The browser could not play this recording.
reolink-wui-event-source-help: Applies only to the bridge selected above. Earlier connected sources take priority. Lower-priority sources stay connected for fallback.
reolink-wui-recording-workspace-unavaila: Recording playback requires a writable temporary directory on the bridge. Configure api.recordings.temporaryDirectory and refresh.
reolink-wui-history-test-authorization: Valkey rejected the credentials or denied access.
reolink-wui-history-test-tls: The TLS handshake failed. Check the certificate and TLS settings.
reolink-wui-history-test-timeout: Valkey took too long to respond.
reolink-wui-history-test-dns: The WUI could not resolve the Valkey hostname.
reolink-wui-history-test-transport: The WUI could not connect to Valkey. Check the address and port.
reolink-wui-encoding-fixed: The camera reports fixed encoder settings for this stream.
reolink-wui-encoding-unsupported: This camera did not report any stream encoding profiles.
reolink-wui-encoding-bridge-required: Update the bridge to read this camera’s stream encoding settings.
reolink-wui-encoding-read-required: Reading this camera’s encoding settings requires stream settings read access.
reolink-wui-clock-bridge-required: Update the bridge to access the camera clock.
reolink-wui-clock-unsupported: This camera did not report a configurable clock.
reolink-wui-live-link-unavailable: This camera’s live view is unavailable to your account or bridge connection.
reolink-wui-osd-background: Draw a background behind the text
reolink-wui-error-CAMERA_DISPLAY_REJECTE: The camera rejected the display settings.
reolink-wui-osd-rejected-fields: The camera rejected the display change ({$fields}).
reolink-wui-osd-bridge-required: Update the bridge to manage display settings for this camera.
reolink-wui-osd-unsupported: This camera did not report any editable display settings.
reolink-wui-bridge-camera-ids-hint: Leave empty to load every camera exposed by this bridge. Enter IDs only to restrict this connection to selected cameras.
reolink-wui-bridge-ws-default: Uses the HTTP API connection’s /ws endpoint and TLS settings. Enable a custom connection only for a different endpoint or credentials.
reolink-wui-bridge-partial-trust: Trust the configured broker certificate through an authenticated tunnel
reolink-wui-bridge-callback-destinations: Name the webhook URLs that may be selected on the Bridge callbacks page. That page creates the delivery rules, camera filters, and event filters. The bridge must also allow each URL in api.callbackDestinations.
reolink-wui-bridge-destination-duplicate: Use a unique name for each destination.
reolink-wui-image-bridge-update-required: The connected bridge does not expose image orientation. Update reolink-bridge and refresh camera settings.
reolink-wui-image-unsupported: This camera has not reported supported flip or rotation controls.
reolink-wui-bridge-test-failure-contract: Bridge API response was not supported
reolink-wui-bridge-test-cameras: Discovered {$count} cameras. Testing does not save settings or send camera commands.
reolink-wui-bridge-id-hint: A unique, stable name for this bridge. It keeps its cameras and access permissions linked when the connection changes.
reolink-wui-connection-verified: TLS verifies the server certificate. A private CA or self-signed certificate can be supplied below.
reolink-wui-connection-unverified: TLS is enabled. Certificate and hostname verification are disabled for this connection.
reolink-wui-connection-plain: TLS is off for this URL. Use https://, wss://, mqtts://, or rediss:// to enable it.
reolink-wui-history-valkey-hint: Each camera has its own count limit. An event expires when its age reaches the lifetime, even if history is being viewed. Enable either limit or both. The feed loads the latest 1,000 retained events.
reolink-wui-history-valkey-require-limit: Enable a count limit or an event lifetime.
reolink-wui-history-default-valkey-limit: Configuration defaults — events per camera: {$count}; event lifetime (seconds): {$seconds}.
reolink-wui-image-control-unavailable: The camera has not reported support for this orientation control.
reolink-wui-recording-reference-unavaila: This recording reference is no longer available. Retry to refresh it from the camera.
reolink-wui-recording-failure-camera-dow: The bridge could not download this recording from the camera.
reolink-wui-recording-failure-conversion: The bridge could not convert this recording to browser-playable video.
reolink-wui-recording-failure-cache-limi: This recording exceeds the bridge’s recording cache size limit.
reolink-wui-recording-failure-busy: The bridge is preparing other recordings. Try again shortly.
reolink-wui-recording-failure-temporary-: The bridge could not use its temporary recording directory.
reolink-wui-recording-failure-preparatio: The bridge could not prepare this recording. Retry or check its logs with the reference below.
reolink-wui-preview-poll-hint: Checks the bridge’s cached preview when WebSocket/MQTT updates are unavailable. With WebSocket/MQTT, it sets the minimum wait after a frame finishes loading before fetching another changed frame. It does not change the bridge’s camera capture interval.
reolink-wui-recording-clock-comparison: At the last check the camera read {$camera} and your clock read {$local}.
reolink-wui-recording-search-partial: Some recording qualities could not be searched. The available results are shown.
reolink-wui-event-coordinates-disabled: The bridge’s coordinate stream is disabled. This alert contains detection state only.
reolink-wui-event-coordinates-not-sent: No object coordinates were included in this alert.
reolink-wui-recording-metadata-failed: Recording detection metadata could not be loaded.
reolink-wui-recording-metadata-empty: The camera did not include object coordinates in this recording.
reolink-wui-recording-metadata-unsupport: Recording coordinates require the bridge’s recording metadata API.
reolink-wui-recording-metadata-truncated: The metadata limit was reached; later detection samples are not included.
reolink-wui-recording-index-failed: The video frame index could not be read.
reolink-wui-recording-index-http: The frame index request returned HTTP {$status}.
reolink-wui-recording-index-range: The video server returned an incomplete or invalid MP4 byte range.
reolink-wui-recording-index-samples: This MP4 has no readable video frame table.
reolink-wui-enrollment-no-targets: This bridge has no enrollment targets and only supports named targets. Update the bridge to enroll a camera by IP from cameras[].
reolink-wui-enrollment-init-help: Enter the full printed UID. The bridge checks the camera over Ethernet or Wi-Fi, sets its first admin password, and verifies the new login. It uses the target’s initialPassword when configured or generates a password.
reolink-wui-enrollment-import-help: For a camera that already has an admin password, the bridge verifies the password configured in this target’s importPassword field.
reolink-wui-camera-setting-bridge-update: Update reolink-bridge, then select Refresh settings to load this control.
reolink-wui-camera-setting-pending: Waiting for the bridge to report camera settings.
reolink-wui-camera-setting-not-reported: This camera has not reported support for this setting.
reolink-wui-lapse-overwrite: Overwrite oldest time lapse when full
reolink-wui-lapse-new: A new time lapse runs all day until you turn it off.
reolink-wui-camera-users-upgrade: Update reolink-bridge to add or remove camera accounts.
reolink-wui-camera-user-add-confirm: Create the {role} account {name} on this camera?
reolink-wui-camera-user-remove-confirm: Remove {name} from this camera? This login will lose access.
reolink-wui-camera-user-created: Camera account {name} was created and its login verified.
reolink-wui-camera-user-list-unknown: The bridge could not verify the change. Reload camera accounts to check the result.
reolink-wui-error-CAMERA_ACCOUNT_REJECTE: The bridge rejected the camera account change. Reload the list and check the username, role and camera identity.
reolink-wui-camera-user-duplicate: This username already exists on the camera.
reolink-wui-lapse-overwrite-help: Turning this off protects existing time-lapse files. If the card fills, the camera can reuse space from regular recordings when their overwrite setting is on. Both types of capture pause when no more space can be freed.
reolink-wui-camera-users-help: These accounts sign in directly to this camera.
reolink-wui-camera-user-uid-help: The bridge checks this identifier before changing camera accounts.
reolink-wui-camera-user-bridge-help: This changes the bridge login through credential rotation using the password you enter. Restart the bridge with its credential vault when prompted.
reolink-wui-camera-user-block-vault: Configure the bridge credential vault to manage camera accounts.
reolink-wui-camera-user-block-rotation: Finish the pending credential rotation before editing camera accounts.
reolink-wui-camera-user-block-administra: Connect the bridge with a camera administrator account to edit users.
reolink-wui-camera-user-block-firmware: This bridge version supports listing users on this camera firmware. Account changes require a supported firmware protocol.
reolink-wui-camera-user-no-write: Password changes require an administrator camera login, a bridge credential vault and supported firmware. Finish any pending rotation first.
reolink-wui-camera-user-unknown: The new login could not be verified. Check the account directly before retrying.
reolink-wui-rotation-help: Generate a password for the account the bridge uses to connect to the camera. Reconcile checks which stored password works after an interrupted change.
reolink-wui-export-png-hint: PNGs use the original time-lapse photos saved on the camera. Choose a gap to export just the photos between recordings.
reolink-wui-export-no-photos: The camera returned no saved time-lapse photos for this period.
reolink-wui-export-no-videos: The camera returned no videos for this day.
reolink-wui-network-rtsp-unsupported: This camera does not expose an RTSP switch.
reolink-wui-network-ip-wired-only: Camera reported only its Ethernet address
reolink-wui-network-disconnect-confirm: Disconnect this camera from Wi-Fi and use Ethernet?
reolink-wui-network-reconnect-confirm: Enable this camera’s saved Wi-Fi connection?
reolink-wui-network-disconnect-requires-: Connect the camera over Ethernet to disconnect Wi-Fi.
reolink-wui-network-no-switch: The bridge could not verify a separately switchable Wi-Fi interface on this wired connection.
reolink-wui-error-WIFI_WIRED_REQUIRED: The bridge could not confirm a working Ethernet connection and a separate Wi-Fi interface. Reload network settings.
reolink-wui-error-WIFI_REBOOT_REQUIRED: The camera requires a restart to apply its Wi-Fi change.
reolink-wui-network-rtsp-saved: The camera confirmed its RTSP setting.
reolink-wui-enrollment-enable-rtsp: Enable RTSP streaming after verifying the camera
reolink-wui-enrollment-rtsp-unsupported: The camera did not report an RTSP switch.
reolink-wui-enrollment-rtsp-failed: RTSP setup failed. Check the setting in Network and Wi-Fi.
reolink-wui-enrollment-rtsp-unverified: RTSP could not be verified. Read its current state in Network and Wi-Fi.
reolink-wui-network-confirm: Save Wi-Fi settings for {$name} on this camera? Its network connection may change.
reolink-wui-network-saved: The camera confirmed the saved Wi-Fi settings. Check its wireless connection before moving it.
reolink-wui-network-ssid-saved: The camera reports the new network name. Check the router’s wireless clients to verify the connection.
reolink-wui-wifi-ethernet: For Ethernet setup, register the wired camera on the bridge. Then open Network and Wi-Fi in Camera settings.
reolink-wui-network-unverified: The camera acknowledged the change. Reconnect over Ethernet or check the router’s wireless clients to verify it.
reolink-wui-network-bridge-update: Update the selected bridge to a build with the camera network API.
reolink-wui-network-wired-help: Keep Ethernet connected while saving. If Wi-Fi gets a different IP address, update the camera host on the bridge.
reolink-wui-network-no-wifi: The camera has not reported configurable Wi-Fi.
